div.div:
Real-Time Control (Paper §3.2):
- Real observations encoded → attention KV cache (prevents drift)
- DiT jointly denoises video + action (coupled in causal self-attn)
- Video Head runs but output is discarded (video aids action quality)
- 16-step flow sampling; 4 effective DiT forwards (DiT caching)
- 7Hz chunk generation; 15Hz action execution (DROID/Franka)
- DreamZero-Flash: DiT caching cuts steps; decouple_inference_noise rescales video sigmas to terminate at 0.8 (orthogonal)
